//: Story Phase 15: the Bashfulness Branch's customers: the night depositors (each richer than the last; served by the branch teller while the captain tries to sleep), the relief queue (Teller Shift V2: each brings modifiers), and Grand Lady Whifflebottom at the AFTER-HOURS EXPRESS WINDOW. Gary is the Phase 14 Gary (the same NPC).

gasimir.name: Grand Duke Gasimir the Excessively Solvent
gasimir.title: Grand Duke of the Overflowing Vaults, Master of Thirty Thousand Grand Wind Crowns, Freeholder of the Upper Draught
gasimir.notes: ALL OF IT. Thirty thousand Grand Wind Crowns. The lantern swung for an hour.

flatulencia.name: Grand Countess Flatulencia
flatulencia.title: Grand Countess of the Seven Generations, Heiress to the Ancestral Breeze, Trustee of the Compounded Gust
flatulencia.notes: Seven generations, compounded. The interest had interest.

billowmere.name: Baron Billowmere of the Upper Draughts
billowmere.title: Baron Billowmere, Lord of the Upper Draughts, Owner of Every Breeze North of the Gusting Hills
billowmere.telegraph: Every breeze north of the hills. All of them his.
billowmere.notes: Regional, at least. Heeled the ship three degrees. At two in the morning.

puffenstein.name: The Dowager Puffenstein
puffenstein.title: The Dowager Duchess Puffenstein, Richest Lady in the Whole of the Afterlife (Atmospherically)
puffenstein.telegraph: The richest of the lot. Her deposit has its own deposit.
puffenstein.notes: Please Notify Authorities. That was the SMALL one.

boomington.name: Grand Lord Boomington
boomington.title: Grand Lord Boomington of Boomington, Boom-Warden of the Booming Marches, Thrice-Booming Knight of the Order of the Boom, First Boomer of the Boomtown Assembly
boomington.telegraph: The title takes longer than the deposit.

pattern.text: Steady. The counter's moving under you.

boomington.notes: Booming. Walked into the wall. Twice. Composure: total.

whistlewaft.name: Grand Duchess Whistlewaft
whistlewaft.title: Grand Duchess Whistlewaft of the... of the Something

pattern.text: A high, thin note. Like a kettle. Like a very ANGRY kettle.

whistlewaft.notes: Whistled. Forgot her title. (So did I.)

fumblebottom.name: Sir Fumblebottom
fumblebottom.title: Sir Fumblebottom, Knight of the Inside-Out Sash
fumblebottom.telegraph: He's holding the form upside down. And the sash. And possibly himself.

pattern.text: The sash comes over inside out. The form comes over upside down. He apologises for both.
He's going pink. So is Brogath, watching.

fumblebottom.notes: Sash inside out. Form upside down. Nearly started Brogath off. Nearly.

wind_brothers.name: The Grand Wind Brothers
wind_brothers.title: Grand Wind Brothers Hubert and Herbert, Joint Holders of the Family Gust (Undivided)
wind_brothers.telegraph: Two of them. They do everything together. EVERYTHING.

pattern.text: They're talking. Both at once. They haven't stopped since they came in.

wind_brothers.notes: Joint deposit. In time. In stereo.

boomboom.name: Grandmother Boom-Boom
boomboom.title: (she says she hasn't got one)
boomboom.telegraph: A sweet little old lady. You've been here before.

pattern.text: A tiny grandmother in a shawl. A tiny, harmless knitted sash.
She smiles at you.
And it doesn't stop. Your assistants are on the floor, eating crackers.

milestones.text: Still going. The shawl is horizontal.

boomboom.notes: DO NOT TRUST THE GRANDMOTHERS. (Second one.)

rumblequill.name: Professor Rumblequill
rumblequill.title: Professor Rumblequill, Chair of Theoretical Windage, Author of 'A Brief History of Gust'
rumblequill.telegraph: He's going to explain it. While it's happening.

pattern.text: He's lecturing. During.

rumblequill.notes: Lectured throughout. I learned nothing. I know too much.

flapworthy.name: Lady Flapworthy
flapworthy.title: Lady Flapworthy, President of the Society for Free Flutter
flapworthy.telegraph: Free flutter. Three yards of it.

pattern.text: Her sash comes over the counter, and keeps coming. Three yards. Four. It's on the floor. It's FLUTTERING.
Somebody needs to hold the other end. Nobody's getting up.

flapworthy.notes: Four yards of free flutter. Brogath held on. (Mellow, thank goodness.)

pattern.text: He looks completely ordinary. That's how it starts.
GARY.
GARY.

thunderpants.name: Admiral Thunderpants
thunderpants.title: Admiral of the Fleet Thunderpants (Retired) (He Thinks)
thunderpants.telegraph: He's forgotten why he came. He hasn't forgotten how.

pattern.text: He's looking round. He's not sure where he is.
He remembers.

thunderpants.notes: Forgot why he came. Remembered in time. Unfortunately.

farthelmew.name: Grand Emperor Farthelmew
farthelmew.title: Grand Emperor Farthelmew the Ninth, Lord of All the Winds of All the Grand Empires, Holder of More Grand Wind Crowns Than There Are Grand Wind Crowns
farthelmew.telegraph: Everything. He wants to deposit EVERYTHING.

pattern.text: A sash like a carpet. It takes two trips to get it over the counter.
He's depositing EVERYTHING.

farthelmew.notes: EVERYTHING. Realised mid-deposit that none of it is real. MID-DEPOSIT.

whifflebottom.name: Grand Lady Whifflebottom the Financially Cornered
whifflebottom.title: Grand Lady Whifflebottom the Financially Cornered, Baroness of the Lesser Gusts, Warden of the Western Wind-Gate, Holder of the Eleven Ceremonial Spoons
whifflebottom.telegraph: The collateral activation ceremony. Both hands on her sash.

pattern.text: Her sash. Very long, very old. The collateral. Both hands.
The collateral is activating.

whifflebottom.notes: Sash-backed loan: 47 silver. Collateral DESTROYED. Loan CANCELLED. Fees: NONREFUNDABLE.
